scope: Prospective exact-profile review for the authorized one-shot captured-only local two-root build; not runtime, PDF, visual, mathematical, or local-deliverable acceptance.
resolved_prospective_findings: Locked terminal/title/heading matching now permits only word-local physical-line-ending discretionary hyphens, while every source character, genuine hyphen and punctuation mark remains required; no global dehyphenation.
Validator rendering documentation no longer promises later artifacts after a fatal parser/runtime exception; ordinary acceptance findings do not short-circuit page rendering.
Final log predicates distinguish actual rerun instructions from normal rerunfilecheck package loading and identity lines.
Catchable child-wait interruption and wait failure enter kill/reap cleanup before status and snapshots; cleanup failure remains explicit failure, not a quiescence claim.

SIGINT is deferred across Popen construction and handle assignment, then restored inside the cleanup-protected scope. The child installs parent-death SIGKILL after UID drop, verifies the expected parent identity, and restores its original signal mask before exec.
Failure records now include a best-effort seal of preceding evidence or an explicit evidence-seal error.
Materialized directories are traversable readonly, child capabilities are explicitly cleared and verified, and no-new-privileges is set and checked.
The audited PAX directory trailing-slash normalization is checked by member kind without relaxing regular or link paths.
nonblocking_descriptive_note: The loader JSON top_level_validator_imports list conservatively includes collections, an indirect import rather than a direct import in the final validator. The exact frozen validator and role paths, not that descriptive superset, control execution.
execution_conditions: The controller must rebind this review by its externally supplied exact SHA256 and rebind all four controls, the source trio, audit and capture before exclusively creating the sole fresh root.
Use only the frozen commands, captured loader/resources and declared source/control/device additions, with the reviewed environment, chroot and identity/resource limits.

Any setup, permission, process, log, convergence, PDF, cross-root or integrity failure stops and preserves evidence. No capture, dependency discovery, root reuse, host fallback, source repair or retry is authorized by this review.
Both roots must pass their automated checks with raw output identity. All page images and final integrity still require separate review before local acceptance.

review_boundaries.administrative_reads: Reviewed notes, frozen source trio, exact capture artifacts/archive members, and /proc/self/status for existing process authority only.

limitations: Static native selection and recorded version-name checks do not prove actual loader relocation, ABI compatibility, dynamic import/dlopen closure, compilation or PDF parsing success.

Read-only capability presence does not establish that chroot, mknod, identity drop or resource-limit syscalls will succeed under the existing kernel/security policy. Any actual permission failure is a stop.

The trusted administrative controller and kernel/filesystem behavior remain assumptions. This is not a network namespace, general malicious-code sandbox, or protection from SIGKILL, machine loss or repeated interruption during cleanup.
The PDF validator is scoped to the exact generated manuscript/profile, not a proof of safety for arbitrary adversarial PDFs. It does not replace final visual, mathematical or cross-paper review.
Batch07 remains incomplete; this review does not change Paper27 acceptance, Paper28 publication status, or pending Papers29-31.
skill_used: paper-compile: fully read; log, physical-content-page, font and visual-review discipline applied under the stricter immutable-source, captured-only, fixed-pass and no-retry contract.
